_comment: Shared by tests/test_diff_continuation_parity.py and frontend/src/components/__tests__/diffContinuationParity.test.ts. Each case is the diff fences of one message, in order. into[i] says what happens to block i: "head" = a diff with its own file header; a number = merged into that earlier block (one Apply button, sent as one diff); null = headerless and not merged. The client rule is chainHeaderlessContinuationDiffs (MarkdownRenderer.tsx); the server rule is _chains_to_previous (app/utils/apply_ledger.py). Change one side only with the other. Hunk markers are written as \u0040\u0040 so no line of this file looks like a hunk header to diff tooling.

cases.name: numeric hunk header continues the diff before it
blocks:
diff --git a/app/x.py b/app/x.py
--- a/app/x.py
+++ b/app/x.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
-a = 1
+a = 2
 b = 1
